renderer.name: FluidSynth
renderer.source: Ubuntu 24.04 Noble binary packages extracted under the user's private renderer environment; no system install

electric_guitar.name: Emilyguitar clean DI
electric_guitar.creator: Karoryfer
electric_guitar.sample_ranges: MIDI key 33-89 multisample; pitches beyond region are rendered by resampling nearest region without altering MIDI pitch
electric_guitar.effects: constant gain, tanh amp stage, low-pass cab coloration, high-pass cleanup

electric_bass.name: Fashionbass clean DI
electric_bass.creator: Karoryfer
electric_bass.sample_ranges: MIDI key 23-65 multisample; pitches beyond region are rendered by resampling nearest region without altering MIDI pitch
electric_bass.effects: constant gain, mild tanh amp saturation, low-pass

drums.name: MuldjordKit SF2 2020-10-18
drums.author: Lars Muldjord; FreePats stereo SF2 mapping by Roberto
drums.preset: bank 0, program 0 MuldjordKit; renderer maps source GM drum roles to SF2 keys 48-66
drums.limitations: FreePats SF2 stereo mapping is a subset of the original 16-channel DrumGizmo kit. GM tambourine (source note 54) is not in this kit and uses GeneralUser GS percussion fallback only when that note occurs.

drum_fallback.name: GeneralUser GS 2.0.3 GM drum map; used only for source GM note 54 tambourine
drum_fallback.author: S. Christian Collins

auxiliary.piano: VSCO Upright Piano Nr1 multisample; CC0-1.0, pinned by ../music-20261030/instrument-manifest.json
auxiliary.pad_and_synth_lead: Existing MIDI synth notes use deterministic additive pad/pluck patch in ../music-20261030/audio_engine.py

drum_role_mapping.54: not present in MuldjordKit; GeneralUser tambourine fallback

attribution: MuldjordKit by Lars Muldjord; FreePats stereo SF2 mapping by Roberto; licensed CC BY 4.0. The MIDI-derived game music uses this kit with an explicit GM-role mapping and sound processing.
